text.arabic_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا۟ وَيَنشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُۥ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَلِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening a fresh identity clause while continuing the prior discourse

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby clause-opening pronoun frame cited for local bookend structure

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens as continuation, not as a detached weather notice. It carries the divine knowledge-and-seeing frame from 42:27 into a fresh identity clause, and the later {{ar:وَهُوَ}} ({{tr:wa-huwa}}) reprise makes the rain, despair, and mercy sequence sit inside an identity envelope.

topics.headline: resumptive bridge from prior divine awareness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rain-relief is linked to the prior divine-awareness context rather than beginning as isolated weather.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on resumptive continuation from 42:27 and QAC marks the opening as a conjunction segment before a nominal clause.

topics.headline: opening sound of the identity envelope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening connector anticipate the closing identity return, so action is framed by identity.
topics.reason: The local opening and closing connector-pronoun frames support the echo payoff.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun fixing divine agency before the relative action clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby spreading verb cited for coordinated mercy distribution
nearby descent verb cited for coordinated action or agency

words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) makes the actor visible before any rain verb appears. The detached pronoun fixes identity first, so {{ar:يُنَزِّلُ}} ({{tr:yunazzilu}}) and {{ar:يَنشُرُ}} ({{tr:yanshuru}}) read as disclosures of the same divine subject rather than impersonal processes.

topics.headline: agency fixed before action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah identifies who acts before narrating what happens.
topics.reason: The pronoun is the subject of the nominal clause and the later verbs recover the same 3MS divine subject.

topics.headline: opening pronoun answered at the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first explicit pronoun returning at the close, enclosing the action sequence in identity.
topics.reason: The repeated detached pronoun is local to words 2 and 14 and supports an identity frame.

words.gloss_range: definite relative predicate introducing the actions as identity-defining content

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby explicit pronoun cited for shared agency or predication

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) is not a loose connector. As predicate of {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}), it makes the rain-sending and mercy-spreading the content of divine identification.

topics.headline: relative clause as identity definition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verbs define the already identified subject rather than simply narrating events.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the relative pronoun the predicate of the opening pronoun and the verbal clause its content.

words.gloss_range: controlled sending down in the imperfect, with rain-relief as explicit object and qiraat texture kept within the same agency
words.root_gloss_range: descent and sending-down field; local grammar selects causative dispatch of rain-relief, not lodging, rank, calamity, or unrelated descent branches

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby spreading verb cited for coordinated mercy distribution
nearby direct object cited as rain-relief

words.prose: {{ar:يُنَزِّلُ}} ({{tr:yunazzilu}}) begins the relative action with controlled descent. Its Form II texture and imperfect aspect make relief an active divine capacity, while the direct object {{ar:ٱلْغَيْثَ}} ({{tr:al-ghaytha}}) narrows n-z-l to rain-relief after exhausted expectation. The qiraat contrast with Form IV affects staging, not the sender; the paired motion with {{ar:يَنشُرُ}} ({{tr:yanshuru}}) lets aid descend and mercy spread.

topics.headline: controlled imperfect sending, not bare weather
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices rain as governed dispatch by the same divine actor, while the qiraat contrast is limited to texture rather than agency.
topics.reason: The Form II imperfect supports controlled sending; V4 keeps the selected branch to sending down and the qiraat row is preserved as form texture.

topics.headline: descent narrowed by relief and paired with spread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a broad descent root becomes a specific relief movement that enters from above and then opens into mercy spreading.
topics.reason: The explicit object, n-z-l plus gh-y-th evidence, and coordination with the spreading verb support this specialized motion.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative rescue-rain, the concrete object sent down after despair
words.root_gloss_range: rain and relief/rescue field; local wording selects rain as succor, not unrelated gh-y-th branches

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby possessed mercy object cited for the mercy field

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغَيْثَ}} ({{tr:al-ghaytha}}) is not just precipitation in the object slot. Its definiteness, rarity, and gh-y-th rescue field make the thing sent down recognizable as relief-rain, and its place before {{ar:رَحْمَتَهُۥ}} ({{tr:raḥmatahū}}) lets mercy appear first as concrete rescue before being named more widely.

topics.headline: definite object as rescue-rain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the direct object itself already carries rescue, so rain is aid before the later mercy noun appears.
topics.reason: The noun is the explicit object of the descent verb; contextual data marks gh-y-th as low occurrence and V4 licenses both rain and relief branches.

topics.headline: visible mercy before named mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from concrete rescue-rain to spread mercy.
topics.reason: Local order and the CRITICAL echo rows support the concrete-to-abstract mercy movement.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the starting boundary of the post-despair timing phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby temporal phrase cited as the completed-despair threshold

words.prose: {{ar:مِنۢ}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the timing phrase a threshold: relief begins from the far side of {{ar:بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا۟}} ({{tr:baʿdi mā qanaṭū}}). It scopes over the whole despair complement, so the timing belongs to the rain-sending act itself; after 42:27, that timing makes divine knowing and seeing operative at the moment despair has actually set in.

topics.headline: from-after threshold for relief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy starts across a boundary of completed despair, not at an ordinary later date.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the preposition to govern the temporal complement of the rain-sending verb.

words.gloss_range: temporal head for after-despair, with distance pressure felt but locally narrowed to aftermath
words.root_gloss_range: distance and afterness field; local construction selects aftermath while allowing remoteness to color the later nearness reversal

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby guardian title cited for the closing title pair

words.prose: {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}) is the hinge that makes despair the landmark after which relief appears. Locally it is temporal aftermath, not a free claim about physical distance; yet its distance pressure prepares the closing {{ar:ٱلْوَلِىُّ}} ({{tr:al-waliyyu}}), where felt remoteness turns into protective nearness.

topics.headline: aftermath as grammatical threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that despair is the grammatical time-landmark that rain crosses.
topics.reason: The local min-baʿd-mā construction selects afterness; remoteness survives as coloring rather than the main parse.

topics.headline: distance answered by guardianship nearness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the semantic turn from after/beyond to near guardianship at the title seal.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly pair b-ʿ-d distance pressure with w-l-y nearness and the local order supports the echo.

words.gloss_range: particle/complementizer packaging the despair verb as the temporal event after which rain descends

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby temporal head cited for after-despair framing
nearby despair verb cited for the completed hope-collapse threshold

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) packages {{ar:قَنَطُوا۟}} ({{tr:qanaṭū}}) as the complement of {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}). It keeps despair from becoming a separate narrative scene and turns completed despair into the reference-state around which rain is timed.

topics.headline: despair packaged as timing complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that despair is grammatically packaged as the crossed boundary for relief.
topics.reason: The particle is locally licensed as the complementizing hinge after the temporal head.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural loss of hope, completed before the imperfect divine actions answer it
words.root_gloss_range: despair and severed expectation; local perfect form marks completed hope-collapse, not ordinary sadness

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby possessed mercy object cited for the mercy field

words.prose: {{ar:قَنَطُوا۟}} ({{tr:qanaṭū}}) names completed collapse of expectation, not ordinary sadness. Its perfect plural form leaves the people unnamed while making their rare despair form the endpoint that rain and mercy cross before the imperfect divine actions continue. The qiraat vowel variant keeps the same predicate, and the mercy echoes, especially 39:53, make {{ar:رَحْمَتَهُۥ}} ({{tr:raḥmatahū}}) the counterforce to this state.

topics.headline: completed plural despair before mercy action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that relief comes after hope has already closed.
topics.reason: The perfect 3MP form and temporal complement place completed despair before the following mercy action.

topics.headline: despair answered by mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy answers the very loss of hope named by q-n-ṭ.
topics.reason: The supplied 39:53 and local q-n-ṭ/r-ḥ-m rows support the despair-mercy relation.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector joining mercy-spreading to rain-sending under the same subject without making it a mere result

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby spreading verb cited for coordinated mercy distribution
nearby descent verb cited for coordinated action or agency

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before {{ar:يَنشُرُ}} ({{tr:yanshuru}}) coordinates the second imperfect with {{ar:يُنَزِّلُ}} ({{tr:yunazzilu}}). Because it is {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) rather than a result marker, mercy-spreading stands beside rain-sending as another disclosure of the same subject. As the middle connector in the ayah's repeated connective chain, it helps segment the movement from identity, to mercy action, to title closure.

topics.headline: two imperfect actions under one subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that spreading mercy is coordinated with sending rain, not reduced to rain’s automatic consequence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the two imperfect verbs under the same subject.

topics.headline: middle reset in the ayah connective chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated connectors structuring the ayah into identity, mercy action, and title closure.
topics.reason: The recurrence of the connector at words 1, 10, and 13 is locally visible.

words.gloss_range: transitive imperfect spreading/unfolding mercy outward, with revival coloring kept under the local spread sense
words.root_gloss_range: opening, spreading, unfolding, and revival field; local object selects spreading mercy, while revival remains contextual coloring from rain-after-despair

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby descent verb cited for coordinated action or agency

words.prose: {{ar:يَنشُرُ}} ({{tr:yanshuru}}) makes mercy an outwardly distributed object, not only an inward feeling. Its surface selects spreading and unfolding, while the revival field is narrowed to coloring: in a rain-after-despair scene it sounds like life released after stillness. Paired with {{ar:يُنَزِّلُ}} ({{tr:yunazzilu}}), the motion shifts from descent to expansion.

topics.headline: mercy actively unfolded and distributed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy is actively spread outward by the same divine actor.
topics.reason: The verb has the mercy noun as explicit object and the n-sh-r/r-ḥ-m collocation supports spread-mercy association.

topics.headline: vertical descent becomes horizontal mercy with revival coloring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both spatial design and life-after-stillness pressure.
topics.reason: V4 includes spread and revival branches; local Form I with a mercy object keeps the main sense to spreading.

words.gloss_range: possessed mercy as the direct object spread by the same divine subject
words.root_gloss_range: mercy, protective compassion, womb/kinship care; local noun selects divine mercy as a spreadable object and counterforce to despair

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby despair verb cited for the completed hope-collapse threshold
nearby explicit pronoun cited for shared agency or predication
nearby spreading verb cited for coordinated mercy distribution

words.prose: {{ar:رَحْمَتَهُۥ}} ({{tr:raḥmatahū}}) names what {{ar:يَنشُرُ}} ({{tr:yanshuru}}) spreads and whose mercy it is. The attached suffix routes the noun back to the same {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) and compresses source and mercy into one surface unit, preventing mercy from becoming an impersonal effect of weather. Its r-ḥ-m field gives the spread protective, life-nurturing force, and after {{ar:قَنَطُوا۟}} ({{tr:qanaṭū}}) it becomes the named counterforce to despair.

topics.headline: His mercy as object being spread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy is possessed by the same actor and actively distributed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the noun the direct object of the spreading verb and the suffix routes possession to the divine subject.

topics.headline: protective mercy answering despair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices mercy as protective, life-nurturing care that answers despair and prepares the guardian title.
topics.reason: V4 supports mercy and womb/kinship fields, while CRITICAL rows tie r-ḥ-m to q-n-ṭ and w-l-y locally.

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening the final nominal title clause after the mercy action

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby explicit pronoun cited for shared agency or predication

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before the closing {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) resets the syntax into a nominal clause. It keeps the titles connected to the rain and mercy actions, but prevents them from being swallowed by the preceding verb; the ayah moves from what He does to who He is. The closing connector-pronoun reprise also gives the opening and closing frames a matching cadence around the relief sequence.

topics.headline: turn from action to attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final titles as interpretive closure rather than loose continuation of the mercy verb.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence license a fresh closing nominal clause.

topics.headline: closing reprise of opening frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing connector-pronoun frame answer the opening frame.
topics.reason: The repeated surface sequence supports cadence and bookend payoff.

words.gloss_range: detached pronoun restarting final predication and assigning both titles to the same acting subject

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby praiseworthy title cited for the closing title pair
nearby guardian title cited for the closing title pair

words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) is repeated before the final titles so they do not feel appended. It restarts predication after the verbs and assigns {{ar:ٱلْوَلِىُّ}} ({{tr:al-waliyyu}}) and {{ar:ٱلْحَمِيدُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥamīdu}}) to the same subject who sent rain and spread mercy.

topics.headline: titles explicitly predicated of the actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guardianship and praiseworthiness belong to the rain-and-mercy actor, not to a detached formula.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the pronoun subject of the closing nominal clause, with words 15 and 16 as predicates.

topics.headline: second pronoun completes the identity frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated detached pronoun keeping one divine referent stable across prior knowledge, rain, mercy, and titles.
topics.reason: The repeated pronoun and referent-chain rows are locally supported by the two explicit pronoun frames.

words.gloss_range: definite guardian/near protector title as first predicate in the closing title pair
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, charge, authority, support, and alliance; local title selects protective nearness/guardianship, not unrelated w-l-y branches

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby temporal head cited for after-despair framing
nearby explicit pronoun cited for shared agency or predication
nearby praiseworthy title cited for the closing title pair

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْوَلِىُّ}} ({{tr:al-waliyyu}}) is a definite title, not a temporary helping action. As first predicate after the closing {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}), it interprets the rain-mercy event as protective nearness and responsible authority. The earlier {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}) made relief arrive after and beyond collapsed hope; this title answers distance with nearness and pairs that guardianship with {{ar:ٱلْحَمِيدُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥamīdu}}).

topics.headline: definite title of protective nearness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guardianship as a stable divine title, while broad w-l-y branches are limited to protective nearness, authority, and alliance here.
topics.reason: The definite nominative predicate supports title force; local syntax and context select guardianship/protective nearness.

topics.headline: post-despair distance answered by nearness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the spatial reversal from after/beyond despair to near protective authority.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly connect b-ʿ-d with w-l-y and local sequence licenses the semantic echo.

topics.headline: guardianship joined to mercy and praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title names the relation implied by mercy and is paired with praiseworthiness in the closing seal.
topics.reason: Rows tie w-l-y to r-ḥ-m and ḥ-m-d, and attachment evidence makes the final two words co-predicates.

words.gloss_range: definite praiseworthy title as the closing predicate/qualitative seal
words.root_gloss_range: praise, gratitude, and recognized excellence; local title names enduring praiseworthiness revealed by mercy, not merely the act of praising

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby guardian title cited for the closing title pair

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَمِيدُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥamīdu}}) gives the ayah its final evaluative word. It is definite and qualitative, so it names enduring praiseworthiness rather than a one-time human response. Whether read as a second predicate or tightly attached title, it remains bound to {{ar:ٱلْوَلِىُّ}} ({{tr:al-waliyyu}}); rain-descent and spread mercy end as recognized beneficence worthy of praise.

topics.headline: definite qualitative praise title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word evaluates the rescue-after-despair sequence as enduring beneficence, not as a passing reaction.
topics.reason: The definite nominative title and ḥ-m-d branch evidence support recognized praiseworthiness as the selected local force.

topics.headline: second predicate or attached title inside one chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that possible predicate/adjective parsing does not detach the title; either way, it stays in the same closing chain.
topics.reason: The naʿt/khabar alternative is preserved with its limit: agreement and attachment keep both readings inside the same predicative closure.

topics.headline: mercy becomes praise at the landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that praise is the evaluative closure of experienced mercy and rain-relief, not an unrelated formula.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows tie ḥ-m-d to r-ḥ-m and n-z-l and to final-word placement; local order supports mercy-to-praise closure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا وَيَنْشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The temporal construction places a delivered rain-rescue only after hope has been cut off; spreading mercy names the widening effect of that reversal.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from above supplies the initiating arrival in the rescue sequence.
Sky-descended rain supplies the literal material event.
Aid at a moment of distress makes the rain function as rescue rather than neutral weather.
The later phase after an earlier one makes delay part of the mechanism.
Severed expectation supplies the closed state that the arrival reverses.
Opening and spreading turns a point arrival into a widening field of benefit.
Tender beneficence identifies the spread effect as mercy.

changed_reading.before: Rain follows a period of discouragement.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately delayed delivery becomes recognizable as rescue precisely when ordinary expectation has been severed, then propagates beyond the initial fall.

baseline_models.mechanism: Rain is the initiating input, while spreading names the downstream reopening of dormant life; mercy is therefore a process of distributed reanimation rather than the falling water alone.

activation_trace.role: Vegetation produced by rain supplies the delayed biological effect of the fall.
Dried pasture greening after rain makes spreading function as reactivation across the land.
Reviving what was dead supplies the larger life-from-stasis mechanism.
The womb as a protected site of growth gives mercy a generative-container dimension.

changed_reading.before: The mercy is another name for the rain.
changed_reading.after: The rain is only the first pulse; mercy is the land-wide emergence, growth, and return of life that the pulse enables.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا ... وَهُوَ الْوَلِيُّ
baseline_models.mechanism: Experienced remoteness and severed hope are answered by a title of gapless nearness and active custody, so delay is not allowed to equal abandonment.

activation_trace.role: Distance supplies the relational impression generated by prolonged waiting.
Loss of hope registers that apparent distance at the level of expectation.
Nearness without an interval directly reverses the inference of abandonment.
Taking charge of an affair makes nearness operational through the rain event.
Supportive alliance makes the delivered relief evidence of protective relation.

changed_reading.before: Al-Wali is a detached divine title appended to a weather report.
changed_reading.after: Al-Wali interprets the delay: the one who seemed remote was actively governing and supporting the transition out of despair.

baseline_models.mechanism: The descent can be heard as prepared guest-provision, the spreading as generosity, and the closing praise as the favorable finding produced by receiving that provision.

activation_trace.role: Provision prepared for a guest recasts the descending rain as hosted sustenance.
Aid in distress gives the offered provision its emergency setting.
Generosity and liberality make the spreading an act of open-handed distribution.
Finding something praiseworthy after experience supplies the recipient-side recognition of the gift.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an impersonal resource delivery.
changed_reading.after: The relief can be carried as hosted, openly distributed provision whose praiseworthiness becomes experiential after deprivation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah frames itself with hidden impartation, repeatedly makes the Book descend, and ends with revelation as spirit and light; the focus rain becomes a material analogue for knowledge delivered from beyond the receiver and unfolded into guidance.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge imparted in hidden fashion supplies a nonmeteorological mode of arrival.
The Book as a delivered object extends descent from water to communication.
Repeated Book-descent stabilizes delivery as a surah-wide action pattern.
Rain is the focus instance of the shared delivery action.
Opening and diffusion supply the post-arrival movement from delivery into effect.
Life-bearing spirit gives the delivered communication a vivifying function.
Illumination supplies the outwardly spreading effect of the received revelation.

structural_cues: 42:3 and 42:52 frame the surah with revelation, while 42:15 and 42:17 explicitly repeat descent for the Book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated revelation, Book-descent, spirit, light, and the focus rain-descent; I supply the analogical arrow that one delivery pattern illuminates the other. A live alternative is that the shared descent language remains parallel but does not make rain a figure for revelation.

changed_reading.before: The verse is an isolated meteorological sign.
changed_reading.after: Within the surah, rain exemplifies a broader life-delivery pattern: what arrives from beyond the receiver opens outward as material growth or guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Competing patrons are contrasted with the sole Wali and immediately with reviving the dead; the focus rain then functions as a visible test of guardianship that can actually move a deathlike state into life.

activation_trace.role: Claimed supportive alliances supply the contrast class whose efficacy is in question.
Taking charge of an affair makes true wilayah effective governance rather than a label.
The life of earth through rain and vegetation bridges resurrection language directly to the focus event.
Loss of life supplies the terminal state over which effective guardianship has power.
Reviving the dead makes spreading mercy the operative life transition.
The focus title identifies the rain-revival as an act of governing custody.

structural_cues: 42:6-9 repeatedly contrast adopted awliya with Allah as al-Wali, and 42:9 joins that title to reviving the dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the patron contrast, the Wali title, death-to-life language, and a branch explicitly linking earth-life to rain; I infer that the focus rain is an efficacy demonstration of wilayah. The live alternative is that 42:9 concerns only eschatological resurrection.

changed_reading.before: Al-Wali means a nearby helper after rain has fallen.
changed_reading.after: The rain-revival is evidence that this Wali can govern the actual passage from exhausted or dead conditions into life, unlike merely adopted patrons.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is repeatedly expanded or constricted, and the immediately preceding ayah says unbounded expansion would produce transgression before naming measured descent; the focus rain is therefore a calibrated threshold intervention, not maximal quantity.

activation_trace.role: Expansion into abundance supplies one adjustable pole of provision.
Rain itself as provision identifies water with the regulated resource under discussion.
Constriction to a limited measure supplies the opposite adjustable pole.
Hypothetical abundance states the condition that would exceed a safe social threshold.
Transgression beyond bounds supplies the stated consequence of unrestricted provision.
Measured delivery immediately before the focus controls the rate of what descends.
Deliberate estimation and ordering make the descent governed rather than accidental.
The rain is the concrete measured provision delivered at the dryness threshold.
Spreading distributes the calibrated input across its field of benefit.

structural_cues: 42:27 is the immediate lead-in to 42:28 and moves from dangerous abundance to descent by measure; 42:12 had already paired expansion and constriction of provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the expansion/constriction pair, the risk of transgression, measured descent, and adjacent rain; I infer a regulatory arrow in which limitation preserves rather than negates mercy. A live alternative is that measure expresses will without implying a protective control function.

changed_reading.before: Spreading mercy means giving as much rain as possible.
changed_reading.after: Mercy lies in a measured release timed to reverse collapse without turning provision into the unbounded excess the preceding ayah marks as socially destructive.

context_deltas.mechanism: A branch of the command to institute religion images an exposed watering place, while the same ayah forbids fragmentation; the focus rain can therefore activate a common-source model in which mercy supplies shared access that should gather rather than splinter recipients.

activation_trace.role: A visible water source supplies the shared-access image within the instituting verb.
Scattering into parts supplies the social failure that a common source is meant to resist.
Rain supplies the literal shared water reaching the land.
Broad distribution makes access extend beyond a private point.
Beneficence identifies the shared distribution as mercy rather than mere supply.

structural_cues: 42:13 places instituting the din and the command not to fragment inside one sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the watering-place branch, anti-fragmentation language, and the focus's distributed rain; I supply the arrow from shared material source to shared normative access. The live alternative is that the water-source branch is etymological imagery with no active relation to the focus.

changed_reading.before: The rain relieves separate individuals or plots.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the distributed rain images mercy as an opened common source whose proper social effect is connection rather than fragmentation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated sowing and increase turn the rain from a completed gift into the beginning of a cultivation process whose yield appears later and can compound.

activation_trace.role: Sowing and cultivation supply the latent work on which rain acts rather than an instant consumable result.
Growth and increase supply the compounding outcome of the cultivated field.
A second promise of increase confirms augmentation as a recurring surah mechanism.
Vegetation caused by rain connects the focus event to cultivated yield.
Dried pasture greening after rain supplies the visible conversion of latent capacity into growth.

structural_cues: 42:20 repeats harth across two horizons and couples one with increase; 42:23 repeats increase for an acquired good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sowing, rain-produced vegetation, regreening, and repeated increase; I infer the temporal arrow from water to latent growth to later yield. The live alternative is that harth remains only an economic metaphor unrelated to the focus ecology.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is exhausted in the moment the rain lands.
changed_reading.after: Mercy initiates a cultivated trajectory: hidden seed and dried field convert the measured fall into later, multiplying yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: Acceptance, erasure of wrong, response, and increase from bounty form a restorative sequence; the rain after severed hope becomes the material pattern of an answer that not only removes deficit but adds beyond it.

activation_trace.role: Reception with approval supplies the opening of a previously blocked relation.
Leaving punishment and erasing wrong supplies restorative removal.
Answering speech supplies the relational response corresponding to delivered relief.
Increase moves restoration beyond merely returning to zero.
Gifted bounty supplies the surplus added after response.
Aid at distress gives the focus rain the form of an answered need.
Cut-off hope supplies the blocked state reopened by acceptance and answer.
Merciful beneficence unifies removal of harm and addition of surplus.

structural_cues: 42:25-26 directly precede the measured-provision and rain sequence and move from acceptance and pardon to response and increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered acts of accepting, erasing, responding, increasing, and then relieving; I infer that the rain materially instantiates that restorative grammar. The live alternative is that the legal-relational acts and weather sign remain adjacent but independent.

changed_reading.before: The rain merely ends a shortage.
changed_reading.after: The rain participates in a restorative answer-pattern: blockage is reopened, harm is removed, and the result can exceed simple replacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ayah immediately after the focus joins creation, dispersal of living beings, and the capacity to gather them; spreading mercy is thus controlled propagation across multiplicity rather than loss of coherence.

activation_trace.role: Opening, branching, and dispersal supply the focus's outward movement.
Creative bringing-into-being supplies the origin of what is dispersed.
Scattering supplies an adjacent lexical parallel to mercy's spread.
Rejoining what is dispersed supplies the counter-motion that preserves control.
Governance makes the outward spread a managed field rather than random diffusion.

structural_cues: 42:29 immediately follows the focus and places scattering and gathering under the same agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent spread/scatter vocabulary and an explicit gather counter-motion; I infer that mercy can diffuse widely without escaping governance. The live alternative is that 42:29 concerns creatures alone and does not qualify the preceding mercy.

changed_reading.before: Spreading mercy is simple one-way diffusion.
changed_reading.after: The spread belongs to a governed scatter-and-gather system: multiplicity and wide reach do not imply dissipation or loss of custody.

context_deltas.mechanism: A single root inventory for what strikes in 42:30 holds both descending rain and an afflicting event, while pardon recurs beside possible destruction; vertical arrival is not intrinsically merciful, so the focus object ghayth and the spreading of mercy determine the descent's rescue-valence.

activation_trace.role: A descending calamity supplies the adverse possibility latent in the motion of descent.
Aid in distress selects rescue rather than affliction as this descent's function.
Rain descending and settling supplies the beneficent side of the shared arrival pattern.
A calamity striking a person supplies the adverse side of the same root field.
Erasing and leaving punishment supplies selective mercy amid consequences.
Being cast into destruction supplies the live alternative outcome to preservation.
Repeated pardon marks the filtering of destructive consequence.
Merciful beneficence explicitly fixes the focus event's positive direction.

structural_cues: 42:30 follows the focus by two ayat and couples an affliction that strikes with extensive pardon; 42:34 repeats possible destruction and pardon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branch-level rain/calamity convergence and repeated pardon; I infer that descent is directionally neutral until its object and effects specify rescue. A live alternative is that the root senses are merely homonymous and should not interact.

changed_reading.before: Anything sent down in the verse's vertical grammar is inherently benevolent.
changed_reading.after: Descent can also name a نازلة or striking affliction; this particular descent is mercy because it is ghayth, reverses despair, and propagates protection rather than destruction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Moving ships depend on wind, while stilling the wind leaves them motionless; by material analogy, rain's mercy is not a static substance but the restoration of circulation across an otherwise arrested system.

activation_trace.role: Expansion and diffusion supply the circulation movement anchored in the focus.
Flowing motion supplies a neighboring material system whose benefit exists in circulation.
Wind and moving air supply the enabling carrier of that circulation.
Removal of movement supplies the causal interruption.
Fixed stillness after motion supplies the system state opposed to mercy's spread.
Rain supplies the fluid input whose effects circulate through the land.

structural_cues: 42:32-33 form a compact motion experiment: ships move on the sea, wind is stilled, and they become stationary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the motion/stilling experiment and the focus's spreading water; I supply the systems analogy that mercy restores circulation. A live alternative is that wind-driven ships and rain are separate signs without a shared functional model.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is a quantity deposited on the ground.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, mercy is restored circulation: the gift matters because it reopens movement through a system that despair experienced as arrested.

context_deltas.mechanism: What is apportioned is spent outward, and injury is answered through pardon, repair, patience, and covering; divine mercy spreads socially when recipients relay provision and restraint rather than terminating the gift in themselves.

activation_trace.role: Outward spreading supplies the focus action that the social practices can relay.
Tender benefit supplies the quality transmitted through material and relational acts.
An apportioned gift supplies the received resource.
Resource leaving in expenditure supplies the outward relay.
Forgoing punishment supplies a relational release rather than retained retaliation.
Removing estrangement supplies the repaired social field produced by release.
Covering a wrong and protecting its bearer from its effect supplies durable restraint.

structural_cues: 42:38 routes received provision into expenditure, and 42:40-43 route suffered wrong into pardon, repair, patience, and covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies received provision followed by spending and injury followed by pardon and repair; I infer that human action can become a relay of the focus's spreading mercy. A live alternative is that these ethics are responses to mercy but not part of its spread.

changed_reading.before: God spreads mercy while recipients remain passive endpoints.
changed_reading.after: The surah permits a relay reading: received provision and forborne retaliation become channels through which the initial mercy continues to spread among people.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later ayat deny a protecting wali, return, and refuge at an irreversible point; this blocks conversion of the focus sequence into a law that despair itself guarantees relief and instead magnifies a rescue arriving while reversal remains open.

activation_trace.role: Severed hope supplies the human state that could be mistaken for a guarantee-trigger.
Gapless nearness supplies the rescuing relation present in the focus.
Denied supporting alliance supplies the contrasting condition in which rescue is absent.
Return to a prior place or state supplies the reversal now sought but unavailable.
Repelling or turning back supplies the explicit no-return boundary.
Refuge supplies the protection explicitly unavailable at the terminal point.

structural_cues: 42:44-47 repeat the absence of wali, return, way out, and refuge, creating a terminal counter-sequence to 42:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one post-despair rescue and a later no-return complex; I infer that the latter limits universalizing the former. A live alternative is that the no-return language is exclusively eschatological and places no qualification on earthly expectations.

changed_reading.before: Once despair is reached, relief will predictably follow.
changed_reading.after: Despair does not compel relief; the verse displays sovereign rescue arriving before irreversible closure, which makes the Wali's intervention gift rather than mechanism under human control.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humans taste mercy and rejoice yet cover the favor when harm follows; al-Hamid therefore closes the focus with stable praiseworthiness that is tested through experience but does not depend on the recipient's oscillating response.

activation_trace.role: Finding something praiseworthy through experience supplies the evaluative test.
Praise for beneficent action supplies the stable title at the end of the focus.
Experiencing and being tried by a thing supplies the recipient's direct encounter with mercy.
Beneficence is the specific experience placed under the human response test.
Expanded gladness supplies the immediate positive but unstable reaction.
Covering a favor supplies the reversal in human evaluation when conditions worsen.

structural_cues: 42:48 explicitly sequences tasted mercy, joy, adverse consequence, and human ingratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies experiential tasting, mercy, joy, ingratitude, and the focus title al-Hamid; I infer an evaluative contrast between unstable reception and stable praiseworthiness. A live alternative is that al-Hamid is a closing formula without this contrastive work.

changed_reading.before: Al-Hamid means that recipients praise God because rain pleased them.
changed_reading.after: The title exceeds recipient mood: mercy can be experientially verified, yet divine praiseworthiness is not created or cancelled by joy, disappointment, or ingratitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gift, fertile-earth imagery, womb, and barrenness place ecological and reproductive generation beside one another; spreading mercy can activate capacity for life while remaining a sovereignly allocated opening rather than a guarantee of fertility.

activation_trace.role: Vegetation emerging through rain supplies ecological generation.
Dried pasture returning to green supplies activation of dormant generative capacity.
The womb as the house of a growing child supplies reproductive generation inside mercy's root.
Giving without exchange makes generative capacity a gift rather than an earned output.
Easy fertile earth supplies a branch-level bridge between reproductive and ecological domains.
Infertility of womb and offspring supplies the withheld-capacity counterstate.

structural_cues: 42:49-50 follow the tasted-mercy discussion by enumerating gifted offspring and sovereignly assigned infertility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-grown vegetation, womb imagery inside rahma, fertile-earth imagery, gift, and barrenness; I infer a cross-domain generative model. The live alternative is that ecological and reproductive fertility should remain separate despite their branch bridges.

changed_reading.before: Spreading mercy guarantees visible fertility wherever it reaches.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, mercy opens generative capacity in land and womb, but the adjacent barrenness contrast prevents turning that opening into an automatic fertility promise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the divine title al-Wali is normally relational, while the cited branch names a rain following an earlier seasonal rain. It remains anchored in the title, the explicit ghayth, and the branch of succession; downstream prose should present it only as a meteorological echo that enriches, not replaces, divine wilayah.

activation_trace.role: The explicit rain supplies the domain in which the unusual wali branch can resonate.
Rain following the wasmi supplies a striking follow-on-rain echo inside al-Wali.
Uninterrupted succession makes the echo function as replenishment following replenishment.
A single descent supplies the pulse that a follow-on rain can repeat.

changed_reading.before: The verse moves from one rain event to an unrelated divine title.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch echo, al-Wali lets the title sound like continuing rain after rain: guardianship appears as replenishing succession, not a single exhausted intervention.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because nushra is a specific treatment or incantation rather than ordinary spreading. It remains anchored in yanshuru, severed hope, mercy, and the later affliction field; downstream prose should call it a therapeutic resonance, not translate the verb as performing an incantation.

activation_trace.role: Cut-off hope supplies the bound or afflicted state needing release.
A treatment that removes affliction makes spreading function as therapeutic unbinding.
Tender beneficence supplies the healing quality of the release.
An affliction striking a person supplies a later context for the therapeutic resonance.

changed_reading.before: Mercy only expands spatially after rain.
changed_reading.after: As a contained therapeutic activation, mercy also loosens the affliction-like closure expressed by despair and restores the capacity to move and hope.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because a published book or unsealed decree is not the surface sense of spreading rain-mercy. It remains anchored in yanshuru and is activated by the surah's written/revealed descent; downstream prose should render it as an opening-to-public-effect analogy, not as a replacement gloss.

activation_trace.role: Writing and inscription supply the textual medium that can later be opened.
A written text supplies the context object for publication.
Delivery supplies the first movement shared by rain and revealed text.
An open book or unsealed decree makes mercy's spread function as publication into public effect.

changed_reading.before: Mercy is distributed materially but remains semantically private.
changed_reading.after: As a contained textual analogy, mercy is delivered and then opened like an unsealed writ: its effects become public, legible, and shareable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cited hamd branch concerns seeking praise by reminding others of a favor, a shadow sense unsuitable as a direct divine-title gloss. It remains useful by contrast with distress-aid, refusal of wage, and human ingratitude; downstream prose should state that al-Hamid excludes, rather than enacts, favor used to purchase acclaim.

activation_trace.role: Aid at distress supplies the favor whose relation to praise is being tested.
Seeking praise through a conferred favor supplies the rejected patronage shadow.
Praise grounded in genuinely beneficent action supplies the positive title.
Compensation or wage supplies the exchange explicitly refused in the surrounding proclamation.
Covering a favor shows that the recipient may withhold gratitude despite having received mercy.

changed_reading.before: Rain is a favor that purchases the recipient's praise.
changed_reading.after: As a contained contrast, al-Hamid refuses a patronage economy: relief is not payment for acclaim, and praiseworthiness persists even where the favor is covered by ingratitude.

strongest_changes: The immediate 42:27 lead-in revises abundant mercy into measured, threshold-sensitive provision.
Repeated wali and death-to-life cues make the rain-revival an efficacy demonstration of governing guardianship.
Surah-wide revelation, Book-descent, spirit, and light make rain a material analogue for delivered and unfolding guidance.
The post-focus rain/calamity root field shows that descent alone is not benevolent; ghayth, pardon, and propagated mercy determine its rescue-valence.
Provision-to-spending and injury-to-pardon sequences allow recipients to relay the mercy socially, while no-return verses prevent treating despair as a mechanical guarantee of relief.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly reactivated the focus's own motions rather than merely adding themes: descent became measured delivery and revelation, spread met scatter/gather and social expenditure, wali became effective custody with a terminal countercase, rahma met womb and barrenness, and hamid met unstable human gratitude. The split غ ي ث/غ و ث mapping preserved rescue alongside literal rain, while contained branches exposed follow-on rain, treatment, publication, and anti-patronage echoes.
remaining_uncertainties: The rain-revelation correspondence may be a structural analogy rather than an intended metaphor.
The watering-place branch of ش ر ع and follow-on-rain branch of و ل ي may be lexical echoes too distant for ordinary prose.
The no-return complex may qualify only an eschatological horizon rather than earthly expectations of relief.
The womb, fertile-earth, and barrenness bridge is visibly packet-anchored but remains cross-domain and exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Rain turns despair into an opened, branching field of mercy.** Lexical evidence: غ ي ث `B001` (rain) and `B004` (relief of distress), ق ن ط `B001` (despair), ن ش ر `B001` (opening/spreading/branching) and `B004` (dry pasture revived by rain), and ر ح م `B001` (mercy). Structural cue and role: descent occurs only after hope is exhausted, then mercy is spatially spread. Abductive move: I infer that rain supplies the material mechanism by which an inwardly closed horizon and a dry field are opened together. Reading change: mercy is visible as ecological relief rather than remaining an abstract attribute.

2. **Patronage follows the pattern of late rain.** Lexical evidence: و ل ي `B010` (late rain following earlier rain), `B003` (assuming charge), and ح م د `B005` (claiming praise by benefaction). Structural cue and role: rain and spread mercy culminate in **ٱلْوَلِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ**. Abductive move: I infer that the unusual rain branch of و ل ي is activated by immediate proximity to **ٱلْغَيْث**, imaging the patron as one whose care arrives even after despair. Reading change: divine charge acquires a seasonal, restorative temporality.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:33's wind made mercy's spread more dynamic: the same ر و ح root that names moving air there and life-spirit in 42:52 lets rain, breath, and revelation form a cautious shared animation pattern.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Guardianship as timely follow-on rain.** **Lexical evidence:** و ل ي `B010` (late rain following the wasmi), a dormant branch activated in ٱلْوَلِىُّ by غ ي ث `B001` (rain sent from the sky), and ب ع د `B002` (afterness). **Structural cue:** the same ayah explicitly places rain after despair, and 42:27 has just described measured descent. **Assigned role:** the rain branch gives guardianship a temporal form: aid arrives as the needed succeeding rain rather than as uninterrupted abundance. **Abductive move:** I overlay the source-attested rain variant on the divine title because the fixed ayah places title and ghayth together; I do not replace the title's authority sense. **Reading change:** ٱلْوَلِىُّ becomes perceptible as guardianship that follows a depleted interval with precisely timed relief.
2. **Spreading mercy revives more than it merely covers.** **Lexical evidence:** ن ش ر `B001` (opening and spreading) with `B002` (reviving the dead), and ر ح م `B001` (mercy and tenderness), anchored in يَنشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُۥ. **Structural cue:** rain follows despair here; 42:29 spreads living creatures and can gather them; 42:30-31 place pardon beside affliction and inescapability. **Assigned role:** mercy unfolds across a depleted field and restores its capacity for life. **Abductive move:** I infer revival from the rain sequence and the root's accepted resurrection branch. **Reading change:** mercy is an expansive life-restoring process, not only an inward attitude toward the distressed.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:29's scatter-gather reversal and 42:33's controlled wind showed that spreading mercy remains governed rather than uncontrolled diffusion. The later atmospheric control also strengthened the timely follow-on-rain activation of و ل ي `B010`.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Despairing dryness is interrupted by descending rain that spreads life and arrives as sustaining follow-up.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The release is timed against exhaustion: after supply seems closed, rain descends, spreads, and revives. Its role as sustaining follow-up makes mercy a continuing provision rather than an isolated shower.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel iniş ile bir yerde konaklama birlikte korunmalı; ettirgen indirme, konuk ağırlama ve savaş kullanımları bu dala katılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın yiyecek, pay, gelir ve konuk adları ile konuk etme ve bolluk bildiren yapılar ayrı ayrı korunur; yapıya bağlı bolluk anlamı bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir konuğun geldiğinde yararlanması için önceden hazırlanan yiyecek, yol azığı ve ağırlama payıdır. Bu çekirdekten konuğun kendisi, ürün geliri, fazlalık, bağış ve bir araya gelmiş pay anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Konuğun yararlanması için yiyecek, yol azığı ve ağırlama payı hazırlanır.
Hazırlanan payla ilişkili olarak konuk kişinin kendisi de adlandırılır.
Hazır pay düşüncesi ürün geliri, fazlalık, bereket ve bağış anlamlarına uzanır.
Bir araya toplanmış pay, konuk için hazırlanmış toplu yiyeceğe benzetilerek anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım konuğa hazırlanan yiyecek, azık ve ağırlamayı temel alır; konuk adı, ürün geliri ve fazlalığı, bol verme, topluluğun geçim payları ve birikmiş pay bu hazırlık düşüncesinden gelişir.

concept_gloss.text: konuk için hazırlanan yiyecek ve ağırlama payı
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın konuğu karşılamak üzere önceden hazırlanan temel payını anlatmak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Konuğu, önceden hazırlığı, yiyeceği ve ağırlama payını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Konuğa sunulmak üzere hazırlanmış yiyecek veya azık anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hazırlanmış yiyecek ile konuğa yönelen ağırlama amacını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yetiştirilen şeyin getirisi, bereketi veya artan payı anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hazır pay düşüncesinden gelişen gelir ve fazlalık uzantısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Konuk için yiyecek hazırlama ve konuğun kendisi anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dağınık olmayan, bir araya toplanmış bir hak veya pay anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Payın bir araya gelmiş ve hazır durumda bulunmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Konuğa sunma amacını ve ürün geliri uzantısını belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: konuğa hazırlanan yiyecek veya yol azığı
bol veren ve eli açık olan

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel hazırlık ve paydır; komşu dal bunun içindeki belirli, küçük bir ikram türüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca yemeğin ağırlama payı bakımından çokluğunu niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bol ve konuk ağırlamaya elverişli yemek kullanımı iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yiyeceğin bolluk niteliğine sıkıca bağlıdır; odak dal hazırlanan payın kendisinden daha geniş bir anlam ailesi kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yiyeceğin özellikle konuk için önceden hazırlanmasını gerektirir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yiyecek sunma ve başkasını doyurma alanı iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal konuk ağırlama amacına bağlı hazır paydır; komşu dal daha genel yedirme eylemi ve tören yemeğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal gelen kişiye sunulacak yiyecek ve ağırlama payıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişinin kaldığı ev, durak ya da soyut derecedir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişinin bir yere gelip kalması senaryosu iki dalı aynı alanda buluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal konuğa sunulan hazırlığı, komşu dal ise konuğun kaldığı yeri veya konumu adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilenler konuk yiyeceği, yemek bolluğu, genel yedirme ve konak yeriyle olan en güçlü karışma alanlarını gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما يهيأ للنزيل والضيف من طعام وزاد وضيافة، وما يسمى نزلا لأهل الجنة أو النار، والضيف نفسه بلفظ النزيل، والريع والفضل والعطاء إذا شبها بذلك.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه المنزل بمعنى الدار أو المرتبة، ولا النزال في الحرب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: النزل ما يهيأ للنزيل؛ طعام ذو نزل؛ النزيل الضيف (maqayis)؛ النزل ما يهيأ للقوم والضيف؛ النزل ريع ما يزرع (ayn)؛ النزل ما يهيأ للنزيل؛ النزل أيضا الريع؛ النزيل الضيف (sihah)؛ حسن النزل أي الضيافة؛ أنزال القوم أرزاقهم؛ أقمت لهم غذاءهم وما يصلح معه أن ينزلوا عليه؛ النزل الريع والفضل (tahdhib)؛ النزل ما يعد للنازل من الزاد؛ أنزلت فلانا أضفته؛ ذو نزل له ريع؛ حظ نزل مجتمع تشبيها بالطعام النزل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanlara veya bir topluluğa zamanın akışı içinde gelip çatan ağır sıkıntıyı ve bunun çoğulunu açıkça tanımlar. Verilen dal çerçevesi olayın ağırlığını, dışarıdan gelişini ve etkilenen insanları doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam başa gelen ağır bir sıkıntıyla sınırlıdır; sıradan fiziksel iniş ya da konuk için hazırlanan pay bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın biçimin insanlara gelip çatan ağır sıkıntı anlamını verir; başka yapılardaki iniş ve ağırlama anlamları içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların ya da bir topluluğun başına zamanın akışı içinde gelip çatan ağır bir sıkıntı veya yıkıcı olaydır.

facets.statement: Ağır bir sıkıntı dışarıdan gelerek insanların veya bir topluluğun başına çatmaktadır.
Olay, zamanın getirdiği büyük ve sarsıcı güçlüklerden biri olarak düşünülür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bütün kaynaklar, zamanın ağır olaylarından birinin insanlara ya da topluluğa gelip çatmasını ortak anlam olarak verir ve aynı türden olayların çoğul biçimde de anlatıldığını belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsanları dışarıdan etkileyen büyük ve sarsıcı bir olayın genel adı olarak kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olayın ağırlığını, dışarıdan gelişini ve insanları etkileyen sıkıntı niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başa gelen olayın yıkıcı ve olağanüstü ağırlığı öne çıkarıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başa gelen olayın ağır ve yıkıcı niteliğini güçlü biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Her ağır sıkıntının mutlaka yıkıcı felaket boyutunda olmayabileceği ayrımını daraltır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: insanların başına gelen ağır sıkıntı veya felaket

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Beklenmedik olaylar ve zamanın sıkıntıları iki dalda kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız ağır ve başa gelen sıkıntıdır; komşu dalın olay ve yenilik kapsamı daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal zamanın getirdiği ağır olayın başa gelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sınama amacı taşıyan rahatlık durumunu ve mal ya da çocukla sınanmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İnsanı zorlayan bela, sıkıntı ve acı iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ağır olayın gelişine bağlıdır; komşu dal güçlük kadar rahatlığın da sınama olması yönünü içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal tek tek başa gelen ağır olayları adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal zamanın bütün sarsıntılarını çoğul ve mecazlı bir anlatımla belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Zamanın insanlara getirdiği şiddetli güçlükler aynı anlam alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal olay türünün adıdır; komşu dal zamanın sıkıntılarını sarsıntı benzetmesiyle topluca anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki tarafın birlikte savaş alanına inip çarpışmasını ve savaş için aşağı inmeye çağıran kalıplaşmış sözü açıkça destekler. Verilen dal çerçevesi karşılıklılığı, ortak inişi ve savaş amacını doğru taşır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Karşılıklı savaşma amacı zorunludur; sıradan iniş, genel savaş adı ve kutsal ziyaret yolculuğu bu dala katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Savaşta karşı karşıya gelme biçimi ile savaş için inmeye çağıran kalıplaşmış söz ayrı tutulur; çağrı anlamı her iniş kullanımına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın savaşmak üzere birlikte meydana inip karşı karşıya gelmesi ve çarpışmasıdır. Aynı alan, savaşmak için aşağı inmeye yönelten kalıplaşmış bir çağrıyı da içerir.

facets.statement: İki savaşan taraf birlikte meydana iner ve birbirine karşı çarpışır.
Savaşmak üzere aşağı inmeyi buyuran kalıplaşmış bir çağrı kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, iki tarafın birlikte savaş alanına inerek çarpışmasını temel alır; ayrıca savaşmak için inmeyi buyuran kalıplaşmış çağrıyı aynı alanın ayrı bir kullanımı olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İki tarafın birlikte meydana çıkıp birbirine karşı savaşması anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki tarafı, birlikte inişi, karşılıklılığı ve savaşma amacını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki tarafın birbirine karşı savaşmak üzere meydana çıktığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklılığı ve iki tarafın savaş amacıyla buluşmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Tarafların birlikte aşağı inmesi görüntüsünü açıkça belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğa savaş alanına inmesini buyuran doğrudan çağrıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Savaş amacını ve aşağı inmeye yönelten buyruk değerini korur.
error_profile.loses: İki tarafın fiilen karşılaşması ve çarpışması sonucunu belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal tarafların birlikte meydana inmesi ve karşılıklı çarpışmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal savaşın, savaş gününün veya savaş kargaşasının genel adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Savaş ve tarafların çatışması aynı olay alanındadır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, hac yolculuğunu Mina'ya gelme eylemiyle anlatan özel kullanımı açıkça destekler. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu hac, varış ve Mina bağıntısını doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam hac ve Mina'ya gelişle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir yere inme ya da konaklama anlamına genellenemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hac yolculuğunu anlatan yalın biçim ile topluluğun Mina'ya geldiğini bildiren yapı ayrı tutulur; ikisi de sıradan iniş anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Hac yolculuğunu yerine getirmek veya bu yolculuk sırasında Mina'ya varmaktır; bir topluluğun Mina'ya gelişi de aynı özel anlatımla belirtilir.

facets.statement: Kişi hac yolculuğunu yerine getirir ve yolculuk sırasında Mina'ya varır.
Bir topluluğun Mina'ya gelişi özel bir anlatımla belirtilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak içeriği, hac yolculuğunu Mina'ya gelme üzerinden anlatır; hem tek kişinin hac yolculuğunu hem de topluluğun Mina'ya varışını kapsar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca haccın Mina'ya gelişle anlatıldığı tarihsel kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Hac yolculuğunu, Mina'yı ve oraya varmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mina'ya varış anlatımının bütün hac yolculuğunu temsil ettiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylemin hac yolculuğu olduğunu açık ve doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Yolculuğun Mina'ya varma yoluyla anlatıldığını belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişi veya topluluğun hac yolculuğu sırasında Mina'ya varışı öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Mina'ya yönelen geliş ve varış hareketini korur.
error_profile.loses: Hac yolculuğunun bütününü tek başına açıkça belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir yüksekten inişi, araçtan ayrılmayı, yağmuru ve genel konaklamayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir yere gelip orada konaklama görüntüsü iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kalıplaşmış, kutsal yolculuğa bağlı özel bir anlatımdır; komşu dal fiziksel iniş ve sıradan konaklamanın genel dalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi erkeğin dışarı çıkan üreme sıvısını, cinsel birleşme sırasında bu sıvının çıkmasını ve kadının bu çıkışı istemesini açıkça birlikte verir. Verilen dal çerçevesi sıvı, çıkış olayı ve katılımcı ayrımını doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Erkeğin üreme sıvısı ve onun cinsel birleşmede çıkışıyla sınırlıdır; yağmur suyu, idrar ve genel iniş anlamları dışarıda tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Üreme sıvısını adlandıran yalın biçim ile erkeğin boşalmasını ve kadının bunu istemesini anlatan yapılar ayrılır; cinsel kapsam başka iniş kullanımlarına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Erkeğin cinsel boşalma sırasında dışarı çıkan üreme sıvısıdır; kullanım, erkeğin birleşme sırasında bu sıvıyı çıkarmasını ve kadının bu çıkışı istemesini de kapsar.

facets.statement: Erkeğin üreme sıvısı cinsel boşalma sırasında bedeninden dışarı çıkar.
Erkeğin cinsel birleşme sırasında sıvıyı çıkarması bir eylem olarak anlatılır.
Kadın, erkeğin bu sıvıyı çıkarmasını isteyen katılımcı olarak anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak içerik erkeğin dışarı çıkmış üreme sıvısını adlandırır; cinsel birleşme sırasında erkeğin boşalması ile kadının bu çıkışı istemesi aynı alanın eylem kullanımlarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir inişin tek seferini ve bir kez daha oluşunu temel anlam olarak verir; aynı biçimin soğuk algınlığına benzer geçici bir rahatsızlık için kullanımını da ekler. Dal korunabilir, ancak rahatsızlık anlamı tek sefer çekirdeğinin kurucu parçası değil ayrı bir kaynak çeşitlemesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tek seferlik iniş çekirdektir; bir kez daha yapısı ona bağlı örnek, rahatsızlık anlamı ise ayrı ve sınırlı bir çeşitlemedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın tek iniş ve rahatsızlık biçimleri ile bir kez daha anlamındaki yapı ayrılır; rahatsızlık ve tekrar anlamları her iniş kullanımına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir iniş eyleminin tek bir kez gerçekleşmesidir; bir kez daha denildiğinde aynı olayın yeniden oluşunu belirtir. Aynı biçim, soğuk algınlığına benzer geçici bir rahatsızlığı da adlandırabilir.

facets.statement: İniş eylemi tek bir olay veya tek bir gerçekleşme olarak sayılır.
Bir kez daha anlatımı, aynı iniş olayının ikinci kez gerçekleşmesini bildirir.
Aynı biçim soğuk algınlığına benzer geçici bir rahatsızlığın adı olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak içeriği inişi tek bir gerçekleşme olarak sayar ve bir kez daha yapısını tekrar örneği olarak açıklar; ayrıca aynı biçimin soğuk algınlığına benzer bir rahatsızlık için kullanıldığını belirtir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aynı iniş veya görme olayının önceki bir olaydan sonra yeniden gerçekleştiği yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tek olayın yeniden gerçekleşmesini ve tekrar sayısını doğal Türkçeyle korur.
error_profile.loses: Yalın tek iniş anlamını ve rahatsızlık kullanımını kapsamaz.

error_profile.loses: Tek seferlik iniş ve yeniden gerçekleşme anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir 'iniş izi taşıyan yer' anlamı kurmaz; yalnız belirli yer nitelemelerinde hızlı su akıtma, sık konaklanma, geniş ve uzak olma, otlaklı yerleşim yeri olma ya da dar vadi olma özelliklerini sıralar. Dal yapısal olarak korunabilir, fakat bu yapıya bağlı yer nitelemeleri dizisi olarak yeniden çerçevelenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın ve genel bir yer anlamı çıkarılmamalı; her nitelik yalnız kendisini taşıyan yer anlatımı içinde korunmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal bütünüyle belirli yer nitelemelerine bağlıdır; hızlı akış, sık konaklanma, genişlik, otlaklılık ve vadi darlığı yalın biçimin genel anlamı yapılamaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yer anlatımları, bir araziyi az yağmurda bile hızla su akıtması, sık konaklanması, geniş ve uzak olması ya da yerleşmeye ve otlatmaya elverişliliği bakımından niteler. Ayrı bir kullanım dar vadiyi adlandırır.

facets.statement: Anlam yalnız belirli yer nitelemelerinde ortaya çıkar ve yalın biçim için tek bir genel yer anlamı kurmaz.
Sert bir arazi veya yer, az yağmurda bile hızla su akıtmasıyla nitelenir.
Bir yer sık konaklanması, geniş ve uzak olması ya da yerleşmeye ve otlatmaya elverişliliğiyle nitelenir.
Ayrı bir yer anlatımında vadinin dar bölümü adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak ifadesi yer nitelemelerini tek yapıda toplar: sertlik nedeniyle az yağmurda hızlı su akıtma, sık konaklanma, geniş ve uzak olma, yerleşme ile otlatmaya elverişlilik ve dar vadi anlamları ayrı ayrı korunur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yağışın kendisidir; komşu dal ise yağışı taşıyan veya onunla ilişkilendirilen buluttur. Taşıyıcı ile taşınan birbirinin yerine geçirilemez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bitkinin çıkmasını sağlayan yağmuru adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yağmur sonucunda yetişen ot veya bitkiyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, yağmurun toprağı canlandırdığı aynı neden-sonuç alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal neden olan yağıştır; komşu dal o yağışın yetiştirdiği bitkidir. Sonuç olan bitki, yağmurun temel anlamına katılmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gökten inen yağmuru tek ve yalın çekirdek olarak öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yağmurun tamamının yanında damlayı ve yağmur arasından çıkan başka unsurları da kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: inen yağmur ile yağmur damlası alanı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da gökten inen yağışı doğrudan adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Temel yağmur bağlamında anlamlar yaklaşır; komşunun damla ve yağmur arasından çıkan unsurlara uzanan kapsamı burada yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yağmur maddesinin kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yağmurun düşmesini ve düştüğü yerleri olay ve konum olarak öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da gökten yere ulaşan yağış olayına dayanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada odak yağmurun kendisidir; komşuda ise yağmurun gerçekleşmesi ve düşme yerleri belirleyici olabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday komşular değerlendirildi; yalnızca yağmurun bulut, bitki, damla ve düşüş olayıyla karıştırılmasını belirgin biçimde önleyen karşılaştırmalar yayımlandı.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه النبات المسمى غيثا ولا السحاب المسمى بذلك إلا في فروعهما، ولا نصرة الغوث المجردة.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu adı yağmurla yetişen ot veya bitkiye açıkça verir. Anlam yağmurun kendisi değil, yağmurun çıkardığı bitkidir; kaynakta bitki ve bulut birlikte anılsa da bu dal yalnızca bitki yönünü düzenler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yağmurla yetişen ot veya bitkiyle sınırlıdır; yağmurun kendisi ve yağmur taşıyan bulut ayrı dallardadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal, yağmurla yetişen ot veya bitkinin doğrudan adlandırılmasını kapsar; yapıya bağlı başka bir anlam içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yağmur sayesinde yetişen ve yağmurla ilişkisi üzerinden aynı adla anılan ot, mera bitkisi veya genel olarak bitkidir.

facets.statement: Yağmurla yetişen ot veya bitki, onu yetiştiren yağmurla ilişkisi üzerinden adlandırılır.
Adlandırma yalnızca tek bir ot türüne değil, yağmurla çıkan bitkiye genel olarak uzanabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adın yağmurla yetişen ot veya bitki için kullanılabildiğini bildirir; temel bağ, bitki ile onu çıkaran yağmur arasındadır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yağmurun çıkardığı ot veya mera bitkisini adlandıran temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkiyi, ot niteliğini ve yağmurla yetişme bağını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Otla sınırlı olmayan, yağmur sonucunda yetişen bitkiyi anlatan daha geniş bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkinin yağmurla yetişmesini ve genel bitki kapsamını korur.
Bitkinin ortaya çıkmasını sağlayan doğal olayı korur.
error_profile.loses: Yağmur sonucunda yetişen bitkiyi ortadan kaldırır.
error_profile.adds: Neden olan yağışı, sonuç olan bitkinin yerine koyar.
error_profile.collision: Yağmurun temel dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Otun veya bitkinin yağmurla yetişmiş olmasını anlamın kurucu bağı yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir yerdeki otu ve merayı, yetişme nedenini sınırlamadan adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yerde yetişen otu ve mera bitkisini adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu genel ot ve mera alanına uzanır; bu dalda ise bitkinin yağmurla çıkması ve adını bu ilişkiden alması belirleyicidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yağmurun ortaya çıkardığı bitkiyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bitkinin yetişmesini sağlayan gökten inen yağmuru adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı canlanma sürecinin sonuç ve neden taraflarında yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yetişen bitkidir; komşu dal onu yetiştiren yağıştır. Aralarındaki güçlü ilişki, iki varlığı eş anlamlı yapmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bitkiyi yağmurla yetişme ilişkisi üzerinden sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bitkinin yeşil, taze veya körpe oluşunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yağmurla yetişen bitki ile taze yeşillik
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yağmurla yeni yetişen bitki çoğu bağlamda yeşil ve taze olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın ölçütü yetişme kaynağıdır; komşunun ölçütü bitkinin rengi ve tazeliğidir. Biri ötekini zorunlu olarak karşılamaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday komşular değerlendirildi; yağmurla yetişme bağını genel ot, yağmurun kendisi ve yeşil tazelikten ayıran üç karşılaştırma yeterli bulundu.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكلأ أو العشب أو النبات الذي يسمى غيثا لأنه ينبت بالمطر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه المطر نفسه ولا السحاب ولا فرج المبتلى.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الغيث الكلأ ينبت من المطر (ayn)؛ ربما سمي العشب غيثا (jamhara)؛ ربما سمى السحاب والنبات بذلك (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı adın bulut ve bitki için kullanılabildiğini açıkça belirtir. Bu dal o ortak kaydın bulut yönünü alır; bitki yönü ayrı dalda tutulduğundan burada yağmurun kendisiyle bulut birbirine karıştırılmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yağmurla ilişkisi nedeniyle yağmur adıyla anılan buluttur; yağan su ve yağmurla yetişen bitki bu kapsama girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal yalnızca buluta verilen bu adı tanımlar; yağmur, bitki veya belirli bir bulut yapısına ait ek özellikler içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yağmurla ilişkisi nedeniyle yağmurun adıyla anılan buluttur; burada adlandırılan, gökten inen su değil onu taşıyan buluttur.

facets.statement: Bulut, yağmurla olan yakın ilişkisi üzerinden yağmurun adıyla anılır.
Aynı kaynak kaydı bu adlandırmayı bitkiye de uzatır, ancak bitki anlamı bu dalın dışında düzenlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak kaydı, yağmurla ilişkili adın bulut ve bitki için kullanılabildiğini bildirir; bu dal kaydın buluta ait yönünü temsil eder.

source_details.summary: Bu kullanımın tek tanıklığı, adın hem buluta hem de bitkiye aktarılabildiğini belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bulutun yağmurla ilişkisi üzerinden yağmurun adıyla adlandırıldığı kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bulut varlığını ve yağmurla ilişkili ad aktarımını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ad aktarımını açıklamak gerekmeyen ve bulutun yağmurla ilişkisini doğal biçimde vermek isteyen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bulutu ve onun yağmurla olan doğrudan ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.adds: Kaynakta açıkça şart koşulmayan, bulutun fiilen yağmur taşıdığı yorumunu belirginleştirebilir.
error_profile.collision: Genel yağmur bulutu adıyla karışabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Bulutla ilişkili doğa olayını korur.
error_profile.loses: Adlandırılan bulutu ortadan kaldırır.
error_profile.adds: Bulutun yerine gökten inen suyu getirir.
error_profile.collision: Yağmurun temel dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yağmur adı verilen bulut ile yağmur
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bulut yağmuru taşır ve iki dal aynı yağış olayında birleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal taşıyıcı buluttur; komşu dal gökten inen sudur. Ad ortaklığı, varlık ayrımını ortadan kaldırmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bulutu özellikle yağmur adıyla anılma ilişkisi üzerinden tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bulutu genel olarak, onun bir parçasını ve ona bağlanan yağmur ya da doluyu da kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yağmur adı verilen bulut ile genel bulut
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da doğrudan bulutu adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu genel bulut alanıdır; bu dal ise bulutun yağmur adıyla adlandırıldığı özel sözlüksel aktarımı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bulutu yağmurla kurulan ad ilişkisi üzerinden sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bulutu havada sürüklenmesi üzerinden açıklar ve gölge ile karanlığa benzetmeli uzanımlar gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yağmurla adlanan bulut ile sürüklenen bulut
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın temel göndergesi gökteki buluttur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Gönderge örtüşse de adlandırma dayanakları ve yan kapsamlar ayrıdır; bu dalın gölge veya karanlık uzanımı yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yağmurla ilişkilendirilen bulutu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dağ gibi görünen, ince ve çoğu anlatımda susuz belirli bir bulut türünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yağmurla ilişkili bulut ile ince susuz bulut
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bulut türleri ve bulut adlandırmaları alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda yağmur ilişkisi belirleyicidir; komşuda bulutun ince görünümü ve su taşımaması öne çıkar. Ortak alan eş anlamlılık doğurmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday komşular değerlendirildi; bulutu yağmurun kendisinden, genel bulut adlarından ve ince susuz bulut türünden ayıran karşılaştırmalar seçildi.
